items.label: High Stretch Seamless Fabric
items.value: These Leggings are made from material 90% Polyamide, 10% Elastane, offering exceptional elasticity and comfort. The seamless leggings design feels smooth and moves with you, offering both support and flexibility

items.label: Motion Flex Scrunch Bum Seam
items.value: Ieumaz elevate your workout with scrunch butt leggings that accentuate natural curves for a flattering lift and enhanced shape. great for the gym, or casual outings, these womens leggings ensure you look great with every move

items.label: Low Ribbed Band for Secure Fit
items.value: These workout leggings feature a low ribbed waistband for a secure, comfortable fit with gentle tummy control. It stays in place, enhances your waistline without digging in, and supports easy, confident movement

items.label: Subtle Glute Contour
items.value: These tummy control leggings shape and highlight your glutes for a flattering look. The contouring effect of these running leggings enhances your curves, giving you a defined appearance and boosting confidence in and out of the gym

items.label: Incredibly Soft Sweat Wicking Fabric
items.value: Enjoy comfort with our soft, sweat-wicking booty leggings for women that keep you dry by drawing moisture away. great for intense workouts or yoga, they blend softness and functionality for high-performance gym wear

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Hand wash with gentle detergent to avoid fabric damage, skip hot water and fabric softeners, and always follow the care label instructions.
